device.description: 12-bit voltage-output DAC with 12-bit parallel interface (CS, WE), LDAC update and power down, 2.7-5.5 V
device.note: slas172f.pdf (SLAS172F) p.1 (pinout), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V), p.5 (timing requirements), p.11 (power-on reset: latches all zero), p.12 (parallel interface: data latched on WE rising with CS low, LDAC low updates the DAC)

registers.name: HOLD
registers.note: holding latch, loaded on WE rising with CS low (p.12); power-on reset all zero (p.11)

registers.name: DACL
registers.note: DAC latch, loaded from the holding latch while LDAC is low (p.12); power-on reset all zero

commands.name: Write (CS low, WE rising)
commands.note: D11 (MSB) - D0 latched into the holding latch on the positive WE edge (p.5, p.12)

pages: p.1-2 (pins), p.3 (ROC), p.5 (timing), p.11-12 (power-on reset, parallel interface)
notModeled: analog: voltage output OUT (x2 gain buffer), reference input REFIN
PD (active low) disables the output buffer only; the datasheet does not say the interface stops, so it is not mapped to pins.powerdown (which would ignore the bus)
LDAC is asynchronous: held low, the DAC updates with the WE rising edge; driven low after WE, it updates then (modeled as LDAC level-active low)
timing requirements tsu(CS-WE), tsu(D), th(D), tsu(WE-LD), twh(WE), tw(LD) (p.5) are not checked; VIH/VIL differ between the 3-V and 5-V supply ranges
variants: C, I and Q temperature grades of the same device
